decision.summary: A single candidate temporary offset in U (695–714) with weak cross-axis support in E and no N correlation; the U dip is multi-sample and sustained, but full return is unobserved within allowed context, and E’s opposing signal is only partial. No confirmed temporary interval.

intervals.observation: U-component shows a multi-sample drop from ~695 to ~700 (from ~9.5 to ~7.5 MAD), followed by partial recovery to ~8.0–8.5 MAD around 705–708, then a second sharper decline to ~7.6 MAD at 714; E-component exhibits a concurrent small negative excursion (~−1 MAD) peaking near 700–702 and a possible opposing return near 710–712, but the U return is incomplete and ambiguous; N shows no matching feature. Return not observed before end of allowed context (729), so status uncertain.
